description: This file defines the 'Reward' model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing customer reward points within the database. It includes methods for adding, deleting, retrieving, and summarizing reward records associated with customers and orders.
external_files: db->query() method (probably part of Opencart's core database abstraction layer)

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model class for handling reward points associated with customers in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Creates a new reward record for a customer, associating points with an order.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a customer, optionally filtered by a specific order.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records linked to a specific order where points are negative.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward records for a customer with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the sum of reward points for a customer.
